verdict.rationale: AgentMail is API-first email infrastructure for agents. It provides string labels, filtering lists, search, and webhooks that a developer could use to build triage. The pack has no evidence that AgentMail itself auto-labels, categorizes, or surfaces priority mail with AI, or that it offers steerable, auditable triage behavior. These primitives are building blocks only and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, AI triages my inbox for me — auto-labeling, categorizing, and surfacing what needs attention — with behavior I can steer and audit
